CustomObject.label: Tariff Change Requested
CustomObject.description: The integration seam to the billing system (ADR-020). When a confirmed tariff change is applied on the Salesforce side, this event is published. In production a MuleSoft subscriber forwards it to SAP IS-U, which owns the actual billing registration. In this portfolio org the far side of the seam is simulated - but the seam itself is real, published, and source-controlled, so the boundary is explicit rather than hand-waved.
